category.title: Furniture category
category.description: Name of the furniture category to scrape, as shown on https://www.moebelix.cz/c/nabytek (e.g. "Židle", "Postele", "Komody", "Sedací soupravy"). Diacritics-insensitive; a category slug like "zidle" works too. Ignored when Category URL is set.

categoryUrl.title: Category URL
categoryUrl.description: Direct URL of a moebelix.cz category listing (e.g. https://www.moebelix.cz/zidle-C22). Takes precedence over Furniture category.

maxItems.title: Max items
maxItems.description: Maximum number of products to scrape from the category.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: Maximum number of listing pages fetched in parallel.

ignoreSslErrors.title: Ignore SSL errors (development only)
ignoreSslErrors.description: Skip TLS certificate validation. Only for local development in environments whose outbound traffic goes through a TLS-intercepting proxy. Leave off in production.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Proxy to use. moebelix.cz sits behind Cloudflare and blocks plain datacenter IPs, so Apify Proxy is required in practice. The proxy password is taken from the APIFY_PROXY_PASSWORD environment variable - never hardcode it.
